Photocopy. Designed to show administrative boundaries in color. LC copy not colored. Relief shown by hachures. Shows administrative boundaries in New York and New Jersey. Also shows portions of Pennsylvania and New England. Insignia of the British Museum reproduced in lower left corner. Scale ca. 1:1,050,000.
